description: DeepLensNet cataract type and severity quantification model (research/non-commercial use only). Takes up to three anterior-segment eye photographs per exam -- a 45-degree slit-lamp photo, an anterior/retroillumination photo, and a posterior/retroillumination photo -- and returns continuous severity scores for nuclear sclerosis (NS), cortical lens opacity percentage (PCTCOL), and posterior subcapsular opacity percentage (PCTPSC).
disease: cataract, nuclear sclerosis, cortical lens opacity, posterior subcapsular cataract
